objectives.statement: Use fordi to give a reason in a subordinate clause and place ikke before the finite verb inside that clause.
Use derfor to introduce a result in a main clause with the finite verb immediately after derfor.
Use så to link a cause to a result as a main-clause connector, usually with subject before the finite verb after så.
Distinguish cause wording from result wording and diagnose word-order errors with fordi, derfor, and så.

notes: Must contrast fordi as a subordinating cause connector with derfor/så as main-clause connectors. Include word-order consequences after each connector.
